title: On the Internal Form and Structure of the Cell — bipolar cleavage field (Figs. 58-59)

source.author: Thompson, D.W.
source.chapter_title: On the Internal Form and Structure of the Cell

claim_text: Early cleavage/segmentation patterns of eggs conform to the same bipolar (two-like-pole) field configuration.

state_variables.pole_separation_2a: Distance between the two similar poles along the egg's polar axis (model parameter a)
state_variables.egg_axes: Semi-major R (equatorial) and semi-minor Z (polar) of the cleaving egg outline in the meridional section
state_variables.ray_angle_theta: Angle of a spindle/aster ray measured from the polar axis at a given normalised radius rho
state_variables.cleavage_plane_normal: Unit vector n perpendicular to the first furrow; Thompson (p. 190) states division at right angles to the polar axis in the equatorial plane

equations.name: Two-like-pole harmonic potential (meridional section)
equations.formula: U(x,y) = ln r_- + ln r_+  with  r_± = sqrt((x ∓ a)^2 + y^2)
equations.role: Scalar potential whose gradient defines the bipolar field with two similar (same-sign) poles at (±a, 0); saddle at origin gives equatorial cleavage plane x = 0

equations.name: Field direction (lines of force)
equations.role: Predicted ray tangents compared to Fig. 58 stipple rays and Fig. 59 drawn lines

equations.name: Equatorial cleavage orthogonality
equations.formula: n · e_x = 0  for polar axis e_x and first furrow normal n in the meridional plane when poles are symmetric
equations.role: Thompson p. 190: division at right angles to the polar axis

equations.name: Reflection symmetry of the field
equations.formula: U(-x,y) = U(x,y)  ⇒  cleavage pattern invariant under x → -x
equations.role: Two similar poles symmetric about the equatorial plane

equations.name: Holoblastic alternation (analogue test on frog plate)
equations.formula: Successive furrows alternate meridional vs equatorial relative to fixed polar axis z
equations.role: Secondary check on CC frog cleavage stadia (analogue taxon)

boundary_conditions: Egg boundary: rays meet the cortex at polar angles sampled uniformly on each lobe of Fig. 58
Poles collinear with the long axis of the hourglass outline (vertical in Fig. 58-59)
First cleavage furrow at the waist (minimum radius) between the two blastomeres

parameter_regime_table.biological_note: Pole separation relative to egg radius (fit to Fig. 58)

parameter_regime_table.note: Fig. 59 caption: two similar poles (not opposite magnetic poles)

empirical_claims: Fig. 58 Cerebratulus first segmentation shows radial aster rays matching a bipolar field (Thompson p. 189)
Fig. 59 explicit diagram of two similar poles with field lines homologous to Fig. 58
Electrical / colloid analogues (Hyde 1905, Lillie) cited pp. 187-188 as physical motivation

reference_digitization.source: Thompson (1917) p. 190 + waist geometry of Fig. 58
